slides.title: Meet Gizmo
slides.text: Gizmo the mouse fixes gadgets in a little workshop. Gizmo knows that every device is a team of parts.

slides.title: Every part has a job
slides.text: Inputs take things in, like the touch sensor and camera. Outputs give things out, like the screen. The processor thinks, storage remembers and the battery powers it all.

slides.title: A tap travels
slides.text: Follow one tap from your finger to the screen. Each part does its job, then passes it on.

slides.title: Hardware and software
slides.text: Hardware is what you can touch, like the screen. Software is the instructions, like an app. You see an app on the screen, but the app is software.

slides.title: Every task needs both
slides.text: A photo needs the camera (hardware) and the camera app (software). And no part works without power from the battery.

words.means: a part that takes things in, like a camera
a part that gives things out, like a speaker
the part that follows the instructions
the part that remembers, even when the power is off

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Inside the Machine at Parts & Jobs and finish 4 levels. Tap the part that does each job, then sort hardware from software.
